info.title: ASN Lookup API - WHOIS Records, CIDR Blocks & BGP Peer Data
info.description: Retrieve complete WHOIS registration data for an Autonomous System Number (ASN), covering the operating organization, every advertised IPv4 and IPv6 route object, and both a structured JSON breakdown and the raw WHOIS text returned by the authoritative Regional Internet Registry. The response also includes the ASN's upstream providers, downstream customers, and BGP peer relationships when the registry publishes them, plus direct technical and abuse contact details. Pass the `asn` parameter with or without the `AS` prefix (e.g. `15169` or `AS15169`). An unallocated or unrecognized ASN returns a `404` error instead of an empty result, and a non-numeric or malformed `asn` value returns a `400` error.

get.summary: Retrieve WHOIS registration data, CIDR block inventory, and BGP peer relationships for an Autonomous System Number
get.description: Returns the WHOIS record for the specified ASN, including organization details, IPv4/IPv6 route objects, upstream/downstream/peer relationships, and both parsed and raw WHOIS text. Accepts the ASN with or without the 'AS' prefix.

parameters.name: asn
parameters.description: Autonomous System Number to retrieve WHOIS data for, with or without the 'AS' prefix (e.g. 15169 or AS15169).

ASNLookupResponse.description: WHOIS registration record for the requested Autonomous System Number.

asNumber.description: The Autonomous System Number, without the 'AS' prefix.

asName.description: Registered short name for the Autonomous System.

orgName.description: Name of the organization the ASN is registered to.

description.description: Free-text description associated with the organization. Empty string when not published.

orgHandle.description: Registry handle identifying the organization record.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the registered organization.

domain.description: Domain name associated with the organization. Empty string when not published.

website.description: Organization website URL. Empty string when not published.

allocationStatus.description: Allocation status of the ASN as published by the registry (e.g. ASSIGNED). Empty string when not published.

numOfIPv4Routes.description: Count of IPv4 route objects currently advertised by this ASN.

numOfIPv6Routes.description: Count of IPv6 route objects currently advertised by this ASN.

whoisHost.description: Regional Internet Registry (RIR) that hosts the authoritative WHOIS record (e.g. ARIN, RIPE, APNIC).

dateAllocated.description: Date the ASN was allocated, in YYYY-MM-DD format; empty if not published.

type.description: ASN category (e.g. ISP, BUSINESS, HOSTING, EDUCATION). Empty string when the category is unknown.

routeObjects.description: IPv4 and IPv6 route objects (CIDR blocks) currently advertised by this ASN.

whoisResponse.description: Raw WHOIS text response returned by the authoritative registry for this ASN.

downstreams.description: Downstream customer ASNs that receive routes from this ASN, when published.

upstreams.description: Upstream provider ASNs that this ASN receives transit from, when published.

peers.description: BGP peer ASNs with a settlement-free peering relationship to this ASN, when published.

legacyRoutes.description: Legacy (pre-RIR) route objects associated with this ASN, in CIDR notation.

RouteObject.description: A single IPv4 or IPv6 route object (CIDR block) advertised by the ASN.

origin.description: Originating ASN for this route, in AS<number> format.

originName.description: Organization name for the originating ASN.

isp.description: ISP or organization name associated with this route.

numberOfIps.description: Total number of IP addresses contained in this route's prefix.

AsnRelation.description: A related Autonomous System (upstream provider, downstream customer, or BGP peer).

asNumber.description: ASN of the related Autonomous System, without the 'AS' prefix.

description.description: Free-text description of the related Autonomous System. May be an empty string.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the related Autonomous System. May be an empty string.

ParsedWhoisResponse.description: Structured breakdown of the raw WHOIS response into individual records and contacts.

status.description: true if the WHOIS response was parsed successfully.

whois_server.description: WHOIS server that returned the raw response (e.g. whois.arin.net).

aut_nums.description: Parsed autnum object(s) for the requested ASN.

technical_contacts.description: Parsed technical contact records for the ASN.

abuse_contacts.description: Parsed abuse contact records for the ASN. Absent when the registry publishes none.

administrative_contacts.description: Parsed administrative contact records for the ASN. Returned for RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC and AFRINIC registrations; absent for ARIN.

as_blocks.description: AS block objects that contain the requested ASN. Returned for RIPE and APNIC registrations.

AutNum.description: Parsed autnum (Autonomous System Number) registry object and its routing policy attributes.

aut_num.description: ASN identifier as recorded on the autnum object.

as_handle.description: Registry handle for the autnum object (e.g. AS15). Not returned by every registry.

as_name.description: Registered name for the autnum object.

description.description: Free-text description lines attached to the autnum object.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code recorded on the autnum object.

status.description: Autnum object status as recorded by the registry.

member_of.description: Route-set or as-set objects this ASN is a member of.

mp_import.description: Multiprotocol BGP import routing policy statements (mp-import).

mp_export.description: Multiprotocol BGP export routing policy statements (mp-export).

mp_default.description: Multiprotocol BGP default routing policy statements (mp-default).

organization.description: Registry handle of the organization that holds the autnum object.

sponsoring_organization.description: Registry handle of the sponsoring organization, when applicable.

admin_contacts.description: Registry handles of administrative contacts for the autnum object.

tech_contacts.description: Registry handles of technical contacts for the autnum object.

abuse_contacts.description: Registry handles of abuse contacts for the autnum object.

date_created.description: Date the autnum object was first registered.

date_updated.description: Date the autnum object was last updated.

source.description: URL of the registry record this autnum object was parsed from.

mnt_by.description: Maintainer objects that protect the autnum object.

mnt_lower.description: Maintainer objects authorised to create more specific objects under this autnum.

mnt_routes.description: Maintainer objects authorised to create route objects for this autnum.

mnt_irt.description: IRT (incident response team) objects associated with the autnum.

notify.description: Email addresses notified when the autnum object changes.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks attached to the autnum object.

Organization.description: Parsed organization (org) registry object that holds the ASN.

handle.description: Registry handle for the organization object.

address.description: Address lines for the organization, as published by the registry.

street.description: Street address of the organization, when published separately.

city.description: City of the organization, when published separately.

state.description: State or province of the organization, when published separately.

zip_code.description: Postal/ZIP code of the organization, when published separately.

country.description: Country line(s) of the organization address, as published by the registry.

addressCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code derived from the organization's address.

date_created.description: Date the organization object was first registered.

date_updated.description: Date the organization object was last updated.

source.description: URL of the registry record this organization object was parsed from.

type.description: Organization type as recorded by the registry (e.g. LIR, OTHER).

description.description: Free-text description lines attached to the organization object.

admin_contacts.description: Registry handles of administrative contacts for the organization.

tech_contacts.description: Registry handles of technical contacts for the organization.

abuse_contacts.description: Registry handles of abuse contacts for the organization.

mnt_by.description: Maintainer objects that protect the organization object.

mnt_ref.description: Maintainer objects authorised to reference the organization object.

WhoisContact.description: A parsed administrative, technical or abuse contact record from the registry. Which optional fields appear depends on the registry.

name.description: Contact's registered name. Not returned for role objects that carry no name.

email.description: Contact email address(es). Absent when the registry publishes none.

address.description: Address lines for the contact, as published by the registry.

street.description: Street address of the contact, when published separately.

city.description: City of the contact, when published separately.

state.description: State or province of the contact, when published separately.

zip_code.description: Postal/ZIP code of the contact, when published separately.

country.description: Country of the contact, as published by the registry (code or name).

addressCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code derived from the contact address.

abuse_mailbox.description: Abuse mailbox address(es) for the contact.

organizations.description: Registry handles of the organizations the contact belongs to.

admin_contacts.description: Registry handles of administrative contacts referenced by this contact.

tech_contacts.description: Registry handles of technical contacts referenced by this contact.

mnt_by.description: Maintainer objects that protect the contact object.

mnt_ref.description: Maintainer objects authorised to reference the contact object.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks attached to the contact object.

date_created.description: Date the contact object was first registered.

date_updated.description: Date the contact object was last updated.

source.description: URL of the registry record this contact was parsed from.

AsBlock.description: An AS block object that contains the requested ASN.

as_block.description: The AS number range, e.g. `AS4608 - AS4865`.

description.description: Free-text description lines attached to the AS block.

admin_contacts.description: Registry handles of administrative contacts for the AS block.

tech_contacts.description: Registry handles of technical contacts for the AS block.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks attached to the AS block.

mnt_by.description: Maintainer objects that protect the AS block.

mnt_lower.description: Maintainer objects authorised to create more specific objects under the AS block.

date_created.description: Date the AS block was first registered.

date_updated.description: Date the AS block was last updated.

source.description: Registry the AS block was parsed from (e.g. APNIC, RIPE).

Irt.description: IRT (incident response team) object linked to the ASN. Returned when the registry publishes one (for example APNIC).

handle.description: Registry handle for the IRT object.

address.description: Address lines for the IRT, as published by the registry.

country.description: Country of the IRT, as published by the registry.

abuse_mailbox.description: Abuse mailbox address(es) of the IRT.

admin_contacts.description: Registry handles of administrative contacts for the IRT.

tech_contacts.description: Registry handles of technical contacts for the IRT.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks attached to the IRT object.

mnt_by.description: Maintainer objects that protect the IRT object.

date_updated.description: Date the IRT object was last updated.

source.description: Registry the IRT object was parsed from.

Contacts.description: Direct contact addresses collected from the ASN's WHOIS record.

emailContacts.description: General contact email addresses for the ASN.

abuseContacts.description: Abuse-reporting contact email addresses for the ASN.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
